name: Ferienwohnung Eisenmann
beschreibung:
Situated on the sunny high plateau of the spa resort Bad Haering, Ferienwohnung Eisenmann provides cosy holiday comfort. The bright apartment features a modern kitchenette and a private balcony overlooking the mountains.

The health centre with healing sulphur springs as well as scenic walking trails through the Inn Valley are right on the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Eisenmann in Bad Haering offers a relaxing retreat in Tyrol's renowned health spa village.
